label: LightningCAD
description: Product demos for LightningCAD. Deliberately thin — the sub-brand's own signature has not been set, so this is the RoleModel base on a blue wash until it is.

rationale.webcamLayoutPreset: CAD demos are about the drawing surface. A presenter PiP covers the corner of the canvas where the tool palettes live.
rationale.padding: Slightly tighter than the RoleModel default so a dense CAD viewport keeps its detail at 1080p.

open: LightningCAD has no agreed colour signature or wallpaper of its own yet. `lightning-wash.png` is a placeholder in RM Blue.
Decide before this ships: does a sub-brand get its own motion language, or only its own colour/type signature over one shared system? This preset assumes the latter.
